question: A simple microscope has focal length $5\,\text{cm}$. Calculate its magnifying power when the final image is formed at the least distance of distinct vision. Take $D = 25\,\text{cm}$.

options.B: For final image at the least distance of distinct vision, $m=1+\dfrac{D}{f}=1+\dfrac{25}{5}=6$.
